definitions.explanation: The activity of risking money or valuables on an uncertain outcome. A general term covering all forms of gambling.

examples.japanese: {賭|か}け{事|ごと}に{手|て}を{出|だ}して{借金|しゃっきん}を{作|つく}った。
examples.english: He got into gambling and ended up in debt.

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}では{多|おお}くの{賭|か}け{事|ごと}が{法律|ほうりつ}で{禁止|きんし}されているが、{競馬|けいば}などは{例外|れいがい}として{認|みと}められている。
examples.english: In Japan, most gambling is prohibited by law, but exceptions like horse racing are permitted.

notes: Also written {賭|か}け{事|ごと} with okurigana. Common collocations: {賭|か}け{事|ごと}に{手|て}を{出|だ}す (to get into gambling), {賭|か}け{事|ごと}にのめり{込|こ}む (to get addicted to gambling), {賭|か}け{事|ごと}で{身|み}を{滅|ほろ}ぼす (to ruin oneself through gambling). In Japan, most gambling is illegal, but certain forms are state-sanctioned: {競馬|けいば} (horse racing), {競輪|けいりん} (bicycle racing), {宝|たから}くじ (lottery). Related: ギャンブル (gambling — loanword), {賭博|とばく} (gambling — formal/legal term).
